name: Move Destiny WebUI port
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
compose=docker-compose.local.yml
backup="${compose}.bak.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-port-change"
cp -p "$compose" "$backup"
sed -i 's/12345/12347/g' "$compose"
podman rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman pod rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman compose -f "$compose" up -d upload-assistant-wastaken
sleep 15
printf 'backup=%s\n' "$backup"
printf 'configured_port='; grep -oE '0\.0\.0\.0:[0-9]+' "$compose" | head -1
podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:12347/api/health || true)
printf 'local_health_http=%s\n' "$code"
podman logs --since 20s upload-assistant-wastaken 2>&1 | grep -E 'Address already|Web UI server stopped|Shutdown complete' | tail -10 || true
REMOTE
description: Move Destiny’s Upload Assistant WebUI to port 12347, preserve the compose backup, and verify the new listener.
